intro_html: Bright, zesty, and just a touch sweet, cilantro lime chicken never gets boring even when you eat it all week. It is high protein, cheap per serving, and the lime keeps every bowl tasting fresh. One batch makes 14 servings.
cost_closing_html: About $4.00 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 servings runs about 57g protein for roughly 578 calories, at around $2.25 a bowl.
upsell_html: Fresh, easy, and endlessly repeatable, this one earns a permanent spot in your rotation. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Bottled lime juice costs a fraction of fresh limes and works perfectly in a slow cooker.
A little honey goes a long way here, so one bottle carries you through many batches.
Stick with the bulk chicken breast to keep the whole thing cheap per serving.
make_it: Put the chicken breast in the crock.
Drizzle with olive oil, honey, and a good pour of lime juice.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken and toss it back through the tangy juices.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Build bowls with rice, cilantro lime chicken, and broccoli.
